subject: Request: support credits for OpenCore Hackday — Nov 30
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@openincubator.org>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: support credits for OpenCore Hackday — Nov 30

Hi Grace,

I'm Lina, community lead at OpenIncubator Labs. We're running OpenCore Hackday on Nov 30 — a lightweight in-person + remote event for open-source maintainers and contributors. We expect ~50 teams (roughly 120 participants) with short 2–4 hour sessions running models and small demos.

OpenIncubator has worked with Redwood for small maintainer grants before; given the number of attendees and model runs we expect, I'm writing to request promotional credits (or a trial extension) to cover compute for demos and quick workshops. High-level ask: the events team would ideally receive enough credits to cover ~1,500 token-hours of inference and a short promo mention on our event page.

Attached is the event schedule and a sponsor deck. Can you let me know if Redwood has a program for events like this and what information you need from our side?

Thanks — Lina
Lina Park
Community Programs | OpenIncubator Labs
openincubator.org
Attachment: open_core_hackday_schedule.pdf
Attachment: sponsor_deck_v2.pdf

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: support credits for OpenCore Hackday — Nov 30

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the note and materials, this looks great. Quick clarifying questions so we can evaluate against our community credits program:
- Expected peak concurrent users / parallel sessions (estimate)
- Rough token model mix (e.g., mostly short chat, some embeddings / longer generations)
- Any security/compliance constraints (SaaS vs. on-prem datasets)

I'm looping in Karthik (partnerships) and Marissa (community programs) to help review and confirm the size of any promotional package. We'll review quickly and get back with a proposal.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Developer Relations | Redwood Inference

Quick internal take after reviewing the deck and Lina's numbers:
- This is a high-touch, high-value community event for open-source maintainers (good signals).
- Technical ask (~1,500 token-hours, mostly short jobs) maps to a modest credit amount.
- Recommend approving a promotional credit equivalent to $4,000 in hosted usage plus a 60-day trial extension for the organizer account.

Operational asks:
- Need MarComm approved blurb for their site (Marissa, can you own?)
- Finance/ops needs a short sponsor agreement and the credit issue workflow. Dylan, can you help with issuance and expiration terms?

If folks are okay with $4k + 60-day extension, I can mark this green.

— Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Confirmed — community credits program approves this.

Action items: 
- Approve $4,000 in promotional credits to OpenIncubator Labs for event usage; credits to be issued to events@openincubator.org and expire 2027-02-28.
- Provide a 60-day trial extension for the organizer account (to support post-event follow-ups and follow-on trials).
- Provide a short sponsor blurb and a single-use promo code that they can distribute to attendees.

Dylan — please confirm you can issue the credits and set the expiration. Grace — I'll draft the blurb and the promo copy; loop me in on the final email to Lina.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Community Programs

- Credits expiry: 2027-02-28

- Promo code: REDWOOD-OPENINC-2026 (single-use for attendees, please let me know required limit and we'll gate it accordingly)

Next steps for you: confirm the email to which we should provision credits (events@openincubator.org ok?), confirm if the promo code should be single-use or N uses, and where you'd like us listed on the sponsor page. Best —
